The types of AI systems banned under Article 5 of the AI Act due to unacceptable risks include:

1. AI systems that use subliminal techniques to influence behavior in a way that may cause physical or psychological harm (Art. 5(1)(a)).
2. AI systems that exploit weaknesses of certain groups (due to age or physical/mental disability) to significantly influence behavior, causing potential harm (Art. 5(1)(b)).
3. AI systems for evaluating or classifying natural persons based on social behavior or personality characteristics that lead to worse treatment or disadvantage (social scoring) (Art. 5(1)(c)).
4. Real-time biometric remote identification systems in publicly accessible areas for law enforcement purposes, with specific exceptions (Art. 5(1)(d)).
